newsitem.title: USA: INSIGHT-Feisty dlr closes in on 120-yen threshold.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT-Feisty dlr closes in on 120-yen threshold.

text.p: With the dollar closing in on the key 120-yen barrier on Thursday, chartists revealed targets beyond that psychologically-important level.
By early afternoon, the U.S. currency clawed its way to a fresh 47-month high around 119.78 yen.
Bank of America technical analyst Ture Johnson said, "My target is 126 (yen) as long as the studies stay positive (and) as long as the trend remains up."
Johnson said the dollar could reach that level by the end of the first quarter.
